name: input
title: Input
description: One text-entry field with a label, description and error; `type` picks text, email, url, password, search, number or tel.

when: Short free text: a name, an email, a code.
Searching or filtering a list or the app.
Entering a number: a quantity, a price, a percentage.
Any phone number a person types: sign-up, checkout, contact details.

instead.when: The text may run to several lines.

guidance.rule: Errors say what happened and what to do: "Enter a valid email: name@example.com".

builtIn: Label, description and error are announced with the input.
Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.
The toggle is named "Show password" / "Hide password".
Formats and parses in the user's locale.
The country button is named with the country and its code.
Too short and too long say so in words.
Required fields show "Fill in this field."
youProvide: A label or placeholder that lists what can be searched.
The range in the label or description.
suggestedCountries for the markets the form expects.

keyboard.does: Increments or decrements by the step.
Opens the country list from the country button.
Searches countries by name or calling code.

genui.description: A single-line text input. Always give a label; use type email, url or tel when it fits. Emits change.
